vocab.definition: The property of a compiled output being up-to-date with respect to its source files.
A JSON manifest mapping scope keys to source mtimes and output paths. Runtime artifact.
A scope whose sources are unchanged since last compilation. Skipped during incremental build.
A scope whose sources have changed or whose outputs are missing. Recompiled.
A composite hash of all TOOLCHAIN/*.json mtimes. Change invalidates entire cache.
Build mode that checks freshness before compiling each scope. Default for local builds.
Build mode that ignores cache and recompiles everything. Default for CI.
A GOV file that, when changed, triggers recompilation of its scope. Declared per surface type.
The act of marking a cache entry as stale. Scoped (one scope) or global (toolchain change).
A scope whose source mtime exceeds its cached mtime. Reported by MONITORING deep health.
